ethics_check.title: Ethics Approval Check
ethics_check.summary_text: All papers that appeared to involve live data collection contained an ethics approval statement.

table.text: Each site collected data with research ethics board (REB) approval and a waiver of consent or as an REB-exempt surveillance activity, in accordance with the Tri-Council Policy Statement: Ethical Conduct for Research Involving Humans. 17 All analyses received REB approval.
table.formatted: Each site collected data with research ethics board (REB) approval and a waiver of consent or as an REB-exempt surveillance activity, in accordance with the Tri-Council Policy Statement: Ethical Conduct for Research Involving Humans. <ref type="bibr">17</ref> All analyses received REB approval.

table.text: Because pan-negative controls were randomly sampled within site and calendar week independently of vaccination status, and children positive for other target viruses were enrolled completely, differential sampling fractions across control groups affect only control composition within each site-week stratum and not the within-stratum odds of vaccination.

ethics_check.report:
Based on the following text, we would expect an ethics approval statement, and it was present:

> Because pan-negative controls were randomly sampled within site and calendar week independently of vaccination status, and children positive for other target viruses were enrolled completely, differential sampling fractions across control groups affect only control composition within each site-week stratum and not the within-stratum odds of vaccination.

Ethics approval statement:

> Each site collected data with research ethics board (REB) approval and a waiver of consent or as an REB-exempt surveillance activity, in accordance with the Tri-Council Policy Statement: Ethical Conduct for Research Involving Humans. 17 All analyses received REB approval.

power.title: Power Analysis Check
report:
::: {.callout-tip title="Learn More" collapse="true"}

Power analyses need to contain the following information to be interpretable: the type of power analysis, the statistical test, the software used, sample size, critical alpha criterion, power level, effect size, and an effect size metric. In addition, it is recommended to make sure the power analysis is reproducible (by sharing the code, or a screenshot, of the power analysis), and to provide good arguments for why the study was designed to detect an effect of this size.

For an a-priori power analysis, where the sample size is determined, reporting all information would look like:

> An a priori power analysis for an independent samples t-test, conducted using the pwr.t.test function from pwr (Champely, 2020), indicated that for a Cohen's d = 0.5, an alpha level of 0.05, and a desired power level of 80% required at least 64 participants in each group.

For a sensitivity power analysis, this sentence would look like:

> A sensitivity power analysis for an independent samples t-test, conducted using the pwr.t.test function from pwr (Champely, 2020), indicated that with 64 participants in each group, and an alpha level of 0.05, a desired power level of 80% was reached for an effect size of d = 0.5.

:::

table.formatted: LAIV and inactivated vaccine provided similar protection against influenza A in 2024-2025, but in 2025-2026, VE was higher for LAIV (76%; 95%CI, 43-94%) than for inactivated vaccine (38%; 95%CI, 23-51%), a difference of 38 percentage points (95%CI, 2-61) (p=0.04) (Figure <ref type="figure">3i</ref>).
